newsitem.title: UK: Alvis firm to buy Omi Intl unit.
newsitem.headline: Alvis firm to buy Omi Intl unit.

text.p: British electro-optical equipment maker Alvis Plc said on Thursday its associate firm Avimo Group Ltd would buy the Omitec Optronics division of UK's Omi International Plc for eight million stg.
The Omitec Optronics Division comprises Omitec Electro-Optics Ltd (OEO) and Omitec Thin-Films Ltd (OTF).
Avimo, listed on the Singapore Stock Exchange, will finance the acquisition partly through its existing cash resources and partially through additional bank borrowings in the UK.
OEO is located in Prestatyn in the UK and designs and makes lenses and optical sub-assemblies for the laser, high specification imaging and avionic markets.
OTF based in Plympton, also in the UK supplies thin film coatings for OEO and also for external customers.

The acquisition is not expected to have a significant effect on the earnings of the Avimo Group for the financial year to September 30, but is expected to be earnings enhancing in its full year of contribution.
